info.name: poc-liquid v3
info.description:
# POC Liquid eKYC — Postman Collection (v3)

Koleksi endpoint untuk **Digiremit x Liquid POC** (BNI Backend).

**Version 3** — Flow baru: endpoint #2-#7 forward ke Liquid API asli (bukan in-memory mock).
Tidak perlu call SDK Apply dulu, cukup gunakan applicant_id valid dari Liquid.

---

## Cara Pakai

1. Import collection ini ke Postman.
2. Ubah Collection Variable:
   - `baseURL` = `http://localhost:8080`
   - `applicantId` = applicant_id valid dari Liquid
3. Jalankan endpoint sesuai urutan flow.

---

## Header Autentikasi
- **BE (`api-key`)**: Semua request ke BE pakai header `api-key: my-test-api-key`
- **Liquid Connector API**: BE → Liquid Connector pakai header `X-Ekyc-Api-Key`
- **Liquid SDK API** (applicantsdk-api / AWS API Gateway): BE → Liquid SDK pakai header `X-Api-Key`

---

## Label
- `[to LIQUID]` = forward ke Liquid SDK API via `X-Api-Key`
- `[to LIQUID CONNECTOR]` = forward ke Liquid Connector API via `X-Ekyc-Api-Key`
- `[MOCK]` = data mock di BE, tidak call Liquid

variable.description: WAJIB DIISI — applicant_id valid dari Liquid. Bisa dari hasil POST /v1/sdk/applications atau langsung dari Liquid dashboard.

item.name: 2. Application Endpoints (flow baru → LIQUID)
item.description:
8 endpoint utama alur KYC.

Flow BARU (v3) — tidak perlu pre-register applicant_id:
- #2 ocr-results           → Liquid SDK GET  /v1/applicants/{id}/ocr_results
- #3 info                  → Liquid Connector POST /v1/kyc_request_informations
- #4 ic-card-info          → Liquid SDK GET  /v1/applicants/{id}/id_document_ic_information
- #5 photos                → Liquid SDK GET  /v1/applicants/{id}/photos
- #6 live-verification-photos → Liquid SDK GET /v1/applicants/{id}/liveness_images
- #7 verification-results  → Liquid SDK GET  /v1/applicants/{id}/verification_results
- #8 kyc-result            → MOCK (tidak ada endpoint Liquid)
- #9 delete                → MOCK (tidak ada data di DB)

Catatan: Liquid SDK API (applicantsdk-api) pakai AWS API Gateway → header X-Api-Key.

header.description: API key untuk autentikasi ke BE

request.description:
GET /v1/applications/{applicantId}/ocr-results

Ambil hasil OCR dari dokumen identitas via Liquid SDK API.
BE forward ke: GET /v1/applicants/{id}/ocr_results (header: X-Api-Key)

Retry: Jika dapat error CE00017 → retry setelah 1 detik (OCR belum selesai diproses).

Field birthday, expire_date: format yyyyMMdd (tanpa separator).
Field yang tidak berlaku untuk jenis dokumen tertentu → null (tidak muncul di response).

Contoh Response (driver's license):
{
  "applicant_id": "1111902224400",
  "id_document_type": "01",
  "name": "TARO YAMADA",
  "birthday": "19900115",
  "address": "東京都千代田区大手町1-6-1",
  "id_number": "012345678901",
  "expire_date": "20280101",
  "zip_code": "1010047",
  "address_pref": "東京都",
  "address_city": "千代田区",
  "address_other": "大手町1-6-1",
  "drivers_license_types": ["普通", "準中型"]
}

Contoh Response (residence card):
{

header.description: API key untuk autentikasi ke BE

request.description:
POST /v1/applications/{applicantId}/info

Daftarkan informasi applicant ke Liquid.
BE forward ke: POST /v1/kyc_request_informations (header: X-Ekyc-Api-Key)

Liquid return HTTP 201 tanpa response body jika sukses.

MANDATORY fields:
- first_name  : nama depan
- birthday    : tanggal lahir format yyyyMMdd (contoh: "19970627")
- address1    : alamat (masukkan seluruh alamat di sini jika tidak dipecah)

OPTIONAL fields:
- last_name, middle_name
- last_name_kana, first_name_kana, middle_name_kana
- nationality : ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (contoh: "ID" untuk Indonesia)
- sex         : lihat APIGenericCode
- zip_code    : maks 9 karakter
- phone_number: 10-11 digit tanpa tanda hubung
- address2, address3, address4
- id_number   : untuk Auto-eKYC option
- resident_status, stay_period, stay_expire_date, permitted_date,
  kind_of_permission, employment_restriction, issue_date
  (hanya untuk residence card)

CATATAN:
- field 'email' TIDAK ada di spec Liquid
- field 'applicant_name' TIDAK ada di spec Liquid (dipecah jadi last_name + first_name)
- field 'date_of_birth' TIDAK ada di spec Liquid (field yang benar: birthday)
- field 'address' TIDAK ada di spec Liquid (yang benar: address1 s.d. address4)

Ref: LIQUID_eKYC_016_RegisterApplicationInfoAPI_v1.3.2

header.description: API key untuk autentikasi ke BE

request.description:
GET /v1/applications/{applicantId}/ic-card-info

Ambil data chip IC Card (NFC read) dari Liquid.
BE forward ke: GET /v1/applicants/{id}/id_document_ic_information (header: X-Api-Key)

STRATEGI: Pass-through. BE inject applicant_id, semua 80+ field dari Liquid dikembalikan apa adanya.

Field berbeda tergantung jenis dokumen:
  id_document_type 11 = Driver's License (Comply to He/To/Chi)
  id_document_type 12 = National Identity Card
  id_document_type 13 = Residence Card
  id_document_type 42 = JPKI (Comply to Wa)

Contoh Response (driver's license):
{
  "applicant_id": "1111902224400",
  "id_document_type": "11",
  "id_face_photo": { "file_name": "..._driverslicense_face.jpg", "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..." },
  "name": "田中 次郎",
  "name_kana": "タナカ ジロウ",
  "birthday": "19900101",
  "address": "東京都千代田区大手町1-6-1",
  "address_pref": "東京都",
  "address_city": "千代田区",
  "id_number": "000000000000",
  "expire_date": "20280101",
  "drivers_license_color_class": "優良",
  "drivers_license_types": ["準中型"],
  "issue_date": "20150101",
  "psc_name": "東京都公安委員会",
  "japanese_foreigner_judgment": "1"
}

CATATAN field yang TIDAK ADA di Liquid (field lama yang salah):
  card_number  → tidak ada
  full_name    → field yang benar: name
  date_of_birth → field yang benar: birthday
  expiry_date  → field yang benar: expire_date
  issuer       → tidak ada (untuk passport: issuing_authority ada di OCR response)
  read_status  → tidak ada

Ref: LIQUID_eKYC_022_GetICCardInfo_API_v1.3.9

header.description: API key untuk autentikasi ke BE

request.description:
GET /v1/applications/{applicantId}/photos

Ambil foto wajah + foto dokumen dari Liquid.
BE forward ke: GET /v1/applicants/{id}/photos (header: X-Api-Key)

Struktur response Liquid:
  face_front_photo   : foto wajah frontal (object)
  id_document_photos : array foto dokumen identitas

Keterangan is_masked:
  false = belum di-mask
  true  = sudah di-mask
  Masked image tersedia 10 MENIT setelah KYC result di-register.

Keterangan is_waiting_masked:
  true  = KYC selesai & masking sedang berjalan
  false = KYC belum selesai ATAU masking sudah selesai

Contoh Response:
{
  "applicant_id": "1111902224400",
  "face_front_photo": {
    "file_name": "1111902224400_1_face.jpg",
    "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..."
  },
  "id_document_photos": [
    {
      "file_name": "1111902224400_1_driverslicense_front.jpg",
      "id_document_type": "01",
      "photo_type": "01",
      "is_masked": false,
      "is_waiting_masked": true,
      "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..."
    },
    {
      "file_name": "1111902224400_1_driverslicense_back.jpg",
      "id_document_type": "01",
      "photo_type": "02",
      "is_masked": true,
      "is_waiting_masked": false,
      "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..."
    }
  ]
}

CATATAN field yang TIDAK ADA di Liquid (field lama yang salah):
  photo_url   → tidak ada (yang benar: image, format base64)
  captured_at → tidak ada

Ref: LIQUID_eKYC_010_GetPhotosAPI_v1.7.7

request.description:
GET /v1/applications/{applicantId}/live-verification-photos

Ambil foto liveness check (selfie saat scan dokumen) dari Liquid SDK.
BE forward ke: GET /v1/applicants/{id}/liveness_images (header: X-Api-Key)

Hanya tersedia jika aplikasi berasal dari SDK (bukan WEB).
Jumlah gambar: 1 sampai 7.

Contoh Response:
{
  "applicant_id": "1111902224400",
  "liveness_images": [
    {
      "file_name": "1111902224400_1_image1.jpg",
      "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..."
    },
    {
      "file_name": "1111902224400_1_image2.jpg",
      "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..."
    }
  ]
}

CATATAN field yang TIDAK ADA di Liquid (field lama yang salah):
  photo_type  → tidak ada di liveness response
  photo_url   → tidak ada (yang benar: image, format base64)
  captured_at → tidak ada

Ref: LIQUID_eKYC_019_GetSDKLiveVerificationPhotosAPI_v1.1.4

header.description: API key untuk autentikasi ke BE

request.description:
GET /v1/applications/{applicantId}/verification-results

Ambil hasil verifikasi otomatis dari Liquid.
BE forward ke: GET /v1/applicants/{id}/verification_results (header: X-Api-Key)

STRATEGI: Pass-through. BE inject applicant_id, 7 top-level Liquid field dikembalikan apa adanya.

Kode hasil (untuk semua field string Number):
  1 = OK
  2 = NG
  3 = Not implemented (setting OFF)
  4 = Waiting

CATATAN: CE00017 jika verifikasi belum selesai → retry 1 detik.

Contoh Response (tanpa Auto-eKYC AI):
{
  "applicant_id": "1111902224400",
  "verification_result": {
    "face_verification": "1",
    "face_verification_score": 201,
    "face_photo_verification": "1",
    "face_photo_verification_score": -18,
    "id_document_verification": null,
    "id_document_verification_score": null,
    "injection_attack_verification": null
  },
  "multiple_user_verification_result": null,
  "reuse_face_verification_result": null,
  "reuse_identification_information_verification_result": null,
  "warning_list_identification_information_verification_result": null,
  "warning_list_face_verification_result": null,
  "optional_verification_result": null
}

Jika fraud detection aktif, masing-masing object punya:
  { "result": 1, "applicant_ids": [] }  ← 1=No match, 2=Match found

Jika AI verification aktif, optional_verification_result berisi 30+ field:
  result, name, birthday, address, zip_code, nationality, sex,
  expire_date, id_number, id_number_match, face_verification,
  face_photo_verification, age, face_liveness_verification,
  face_liveness_verification_score, injection_attack_verification, dll.

CATATAN field yang TIDAK ADA di Liquid (field lama yang salah):
  verification_status  → tidak ada
  face_match_score     → yang benar: verification_result.face_verification_score
  liveness_result      → yang benar: verification_result.face_verification
  document_authenticity → yang benar: verification_result.id_document_verification
  verified_at          → tidak ada

item.name: 3. Orchestration
item.description:
Single endpoint yang aggregate 5 Liquid API call.

Flow:
- Step 1 SEQUENTIAL: RegisterApplicationInfo (POST) → Liquid Connector (X-Ekyc-Api-Key)
- Delay 1 detik
- Step 2-5 PARALLEL: GetICCardInfo, GetPhotos, GetLivenessImages, GetVerificationResults → Liquid SDK (X-Api-Key)
- Aggregate dan return semua response

Retry: 3x (fixed delay 1 detik) untuk error CE00017/CE00008/CE00004/network/5xx.

header.description: API key untuk autentikasi ke BE

request.description:
POST /v1/orchestration/{applicantId}/process-kyc

Single endpoint yang aggregate 5 Liquid API call.

Flow Internal:
1. [SEQUENTIAL] RegisterApplicationInfo  -> POST /v1/kyc_request_informations (X-Ekyc-Api-Key)
   (delay 1 detik)
2. [PARALLEL]
   - GetICCardInfo           -> GET /v1/applicants/{id}/id_document_ic_information (X-Api-Key)
   - GetPhotos               -> GET /v1/applicants/{id}/photos (X-Api-Key)
   - GetLivenessImages       -> GET /v1/applicants/{id}/liveness_images (X-Api-Key)
   - GetVerificationResults  -> GET /v1/applicants/{id}/verification_results (X-Api-Key)

Contoh Response:
{
  "applicant_id": "...",
  "register_info": { "application_id": "...", "status": "registered" },
  "ic_card_info": { "card_number": "...", "full_name": "..." },
  "photos": [ { "photo_type": "document_front", "photo_url": "..." } ],
  "liveness_images": [ { "photo_type": "liveness", "photo_url": "..." } ],
  "verification_results": { "verification_status": "approved", "face_match_score": 0.98 }
}
